name: typos-format
description: Spell-check at commit time via typos-cli: a git pre-commit entry that blocks only on typos in the lines a commit adds, with an opt-in end-of-turn check, honoring the consuming repo's own typos configuration.

typos_format_enabled.title: Spell-check session hooks
typos_format_enabled.description: Kill switch for the plugin's Claude Code hooks: the SessionStart probe and drift line, and the opt-in end-of-turn check. On by default. The git pre-commit entry is installed separately and is not affected.

typos_format_end_of_turn.title: Spell-check uncommitted changes at turn end
typos_format_end_of_turn.description: At the end of each turn, run the pre-commit typos check over the lines changed since the last commit and hand any findings back so they are fixed before the turn ends, at most once per turn. Off by default.
